incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service=inference-api severity=sev2 signal=latency_p99 threshold=1800ms region=us-west :rotating_light:
maria: acked the page, I'm oncall for this window. grabbing logs and tracing.
aj: on standby, checking autoscaler + kv cache heat. any deploys in last 10m?
sam: saw a customer thread in #support about slow responses starting ~09:12 UTC. no error codes, just very long waits.
maria: can confirm p95 ~1200ms, p99 ~3.2s on /v1/generate. spike started at 09:11. no obvious 500s.
aj: looking at sidecar CPU across pods -> a few pods at 95% in us-west-2. suspect batcher backlog.
maria: pulling recent rollout events: last model routing tweak at 09:05 (canary -> v2-quant). rolling back to v1 for rapid test? :thinking_face:
sam: if v2-quant is causing longer kernel paths we could see tail latency. v1 is heavier but more predictable.
maria: temp plan: route 30% traffic back to v1, scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPUs in us-west, and clear KV prefix cache for hotkeys. executing now.
aj: autoscaler manual scale +2 GPUs requested (ticket id: AS-9821). triggering cache eviction for prefix 'inference:pref:'
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-8742 acknowledged by maria. Escalation step halted.
maria: starting rollout change: routing config -> set route inference-api-usw to model=v1, weight=30%. will monitor p99.
aj: cache eviction command run: `redis-cli --eval evict_prefix.lua inference:pref:`. batcher backlog drains in progress.
maria: logs show a steady stream of long KV get ops hitting backend redis cluster (latency ~80ms each) -> amplifying token step time.
sam: any customer-visible failures? should we open a brief status note?
maria: customer impact: intermittent slow completions for ~7% of requests in us-west, error rate unchanged. creating quick status page update: "Degraded performance for inference in US-West; investigating".
aj: p99 dropping: now 1.1s after rollout change. good signal. keep observing for 5m.
maria: holding oncall handoff for now. @sam please ping support to prep canned reply: "We're mitigating increased tail latency; no data loss."
sam: will post to support and stand by for customer escalations.
incident-bot: Note: if p99 rises above 2s again, PagerDuty will auto-escalate in 8m.
maria: ack. if it remains under 1.5s at next check (09:23) we'll keep the routing change and start gradual rollback to previous capacity plan.
aj: follow-up action items: investigate why v2-quant path increases KV ops; add perf regression test on canary for KV-heavy prompts. filing a ticket: INF-4312.
maria: leaving thread notes for next oncall. final state at 09:24: p95=850ms p99=980ms in us-west, routing at 30% v1. will update runbook with steps taken. handing off to night oncall at 09:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
